description: Add symbols to the user's personal watchlist (stored server-side, follows their API key across Claude/ChatGPT/any MCP client; max 50 symbols). Tickers must be EXCHANGE:SYMBOL, comma-separated — e.g. 'KUCOIN:BTCUSDT, NASDAQ:NVDA, BIST:THYAO, COMEX:GC1!'. Mixing asset classes is fine — crypto, stocks, futures, FX in one list.
name: watchlist_add
